objective: P1-8: Sub portal draw status visibility

evidence.output_tail: Done. Here's what was implemented:  **`app/sub/projects/[projectId]/invoices/[invoiceId]/page.tsx`** - Fetches draw data (status, drawNumber, submittedAt, approvedAt, fundedAt) when `invoice.drawId` is set (flat query, no nested includes) - Adds a 7-step pipeline display: **Submitted → GC Reviewing → GC Approved → In Draw → With Lender → Draw Approved → Paid** - Step derivation: SUBMITTED→2, subApprovalStatus APPROVED/INCLUDED_IN_DRAW→3, drawId set→4, draw SUBMITTED/UNDER_REVIE
